techguns.jei.bioblob.info: Charged Bio Gun shots with block damage leave Bioblobs on surfaces. They shrink and vanish after a few seconds; shooting one again makes it grow until it bursts in a poison explosion.
techguns.jei.tg_spawner.info: Dungeon spawner. Keeps up to 3 monsters alive near it until 5 of them have been killed, then disappears. Unbreakable; placed by hand a Monster Hole spawns Zombie Soldiers and a Military Spawn Point spawns Army Soldiers.

techguns.jei.door3x3.info: A 3x3 door, placed with its bottom middle on the clicked block. Right click opens it; sneak right click with an empty hand or a wrench opens the settings: manual (with optional auto close), redstone or player detector mode. Hangar doors next to each other or stacked open together.
techguns.jei.explosivecharge.info: Place on a block and open it to set the blast radius, depth and delay, then press Detonate. It breaks a square tunnel into the block it is attached to and drops the mined blocks. Mining charges break blocks softer than obsidian, advanced charges also break obsidian (limits set in the server config).
techguns.jei.militarycrate.info: Found in structures. Broken by a player it drops random loot; with Silk Touch it drops the crate itself.
techguns.jei.multiblock.fabricator: 2x2x2: controller in a bottom corner, 3 housing blocks below and 4 glass blocks on top. Right click the side of the controller that should be the front; the machine extends behind it and to the left (seen from the front).
techguns.jei.multiblock.oredrill: Place a line of rods starting at an ore cluster, then engines, then the controller touching the last engine. Small drill: controller, 1 rod, cluster. Bigger drills: engines can be widened to a square (radius 1-3), the engine line must be longer than that radius, the rod line at least as long as the engine line and as wide as the engine square. A frame one block wider than the engines encloses engines and rods: edges are frame blocks, the faces scaffold, the space around the rods air. Right click the controller to form.
techguns.jei.multiblock.reactionchamber: 3x4x3: bottom and top layer housing, the two layers in between glass. The controller replaces the housing in the middle of a bottom side. Right click the outer side of the controller to form it. The housings next to the bottom center take items and fluids, the top center housing takes energy.
techguns.jei.orecluster.info: Ore clusters can not be mined by hand. An ore drill on top of the cluster mines them endlessly; bigger clusters (up to the drill length) and better drill heads mine faster.
techguns.jei.radiation.info: Radiation adds RAD every second (less with RAD resistance from hazmat-style armor, gas masks or Anti-RAD pills). From 500 RAD you get sick, from 1000 RAD you take damage. RadAway and Anti-RAD pills remove RAD; dying removes 200 RAD.
techguns.jei.turret.info: Place on a block for a standing turret, or under a block for a hanging one. Put a gun in the weapon slot and its ammo in the input slots; empty magazines go to the output slots. Needs power (FE) to run, heal and rebuild the turret after it was destroyed. Energy weapons can reload straight from the stored FE instead of using energy cells (one cell costs as much FE as charging it). Turret armor raises its armor and changes its look.
